PK concentrations by subject with their summary: a table plan from the template pk_conc

Source: R/tpl_pk.R
tpl_pk_conc.Rd

One table, a page per group (by: the analyte PARAM, the arm TRT01A): the subjects' concentrations above, one row a subject ({USUBJID}/{AGE}/{SEX}), the time points across (ATPT, in the order of ATPTN), and their summary statistics below over the same columns (N, Mean, SD, SE, CV(%), Median, Min, Max). A record below the limit of quantification (blq, an R condition) prints BLQ in the listing; the summary reads the non-missing values. The summary is laid under the listing by rtfreporter's plan_append(); split_at starts a second block of columns at a time point.

Usage

tpl_pk_conc(data, ard, population, ..., codelists = NULL)

Arguments

data

The listing's records: the concentrations, one row a sample.

ard

The summary's ARD: the statistics by the groups and the time point (the template's analysis, not normalized).

population

The analysis set's id ("PK").

...

The template's other parameters: where, by, heading, time, time_order, times, value, blq, blq_label, cell, subject, subject_heading, time_heading, summary_label, stats, split_at ...

codelists

The report's code lists; NULL takes the data's.

Value

A rtfreporter::table_plan().

Examples

x <- tfl_template_expand("pk_conc", list(population = "PK", blq = "BLQFL == \"Y\""))
vapply(x$content, `[[`, "", "fn")
#> [1] "table_plan"         "plan_cells"         "plan_append"       
#> [4] "plan_stub"          "plan_blanks"        "plan_col_header"   
#> [7] "plan_paginate_rows" "plan_columns"
